caption: Each column is one CPU and each cell is the share of one CPU that a task on that CPU gets. With no affinity every task gets 0.5 CPU; after four tasks are pinned to CPU 0 those four get 0.25 CPU each and the four left on CPUs 1–3 get 0.75 CPU each.

spec.title: 8 tasks on 4 CPUs: share of one CPU per task
spec.aria: A two-row table of four CPUs: with no affinity each of the eight tasks gets 0.5 CPU, and after pinning four tasks to CPU 0 each pinned task gets 0.25 CPU while the four unpinned tasks on CPUs 1 to 3 get 0.75 CPU each.
